lines.zh: 底座压进土里，我定住了。
lines.en: My base sank into the soil and I am fixed.
I do not walk. I get positioned.
All four corners sit on the ground.

lines.zh: 有人把我的正面转了向。
lines.en: Someone turned my face round.
I was pushed behind the line.
The facing has been adjusted.
A little soil squeezes out along my rim.
The wind blows right across my face.
The board pales in the light.
I lean on two wooden stakes.
After being moved I rocked once.
I have taken the load again.
My face looks onto the open ground.
A shield needs no sleep.
The corners have been worn round.
There is an old crack in the board.
I have stood here a long time.
The wood has dried in the sun.
A plank does not feed.
Mud has splashed my lower edge.
I wait to be struck.
The sun has cracked my grain.
A little light shows through my back.

lines.zh: 我的影子盖住一小片草。
lines.en: My shadow covers a patch of grass.
One nail has loosened.
I stand quite upright.
Make your strike land true.
This is my hardest part.
Space your feet wider.
I stand in the open ground.
Going behind will do you no good.
The face may break, but the frame holds.
Hold back and the strike weakens.
You raise your hand and I brace.
You brought nothing with you.
This face is wide enough for you.
Striking me makes something improve.

lines.zh: 你什么时候打，我什么时候接。
lines.en: Whenever you strike, I take it.
The board rocked once.
The nail hole widened a little.
I have no nerves.
Wood fibres bent inward.
I am still up on the stakes.
The rim is still humming.
Soil squeezes out from the base.
That blow had weight.
A corner of paint chipped off.
I took all of it.
I have no mouth for that.
Set your things on the ground.
This pile of wood does not eat that.
You will find a use for it.
I am here to train defence.
Better to hit me than to feed me.
That is not mine to take.
Move it, it is blocking the line.
I can taste nothing.
Put it back in your bag.
You hit the face and the sound is dull.
The soil under me loosened a finger's width.
I press back into place.
Both stakes creaked.
The nail hole split a hair.
I did not buckle at all.
Your own force pushed you back.
The wind scatters the dust.
I am taking the load again.
Smash it once more.
The sandbag next to me is still swinging.
I take the blocks. It takes the hits.
Two pieces of gear, one line.
Wood says nothing to wood.
Someone will use us together.
The stakes are my only legs.
An old face still blocks.
Neither of us walks away.
Just hold steady.
Come and train.
A plank has no fingers.
I cannot even bend.
The thing is lying at my foot.
I am standing. I cannot reach.
It is wedged between me and a stake.
The wind rolled it off a little.
You will have to stoop yourself.
I cannot shift my place.
That is not my work.
Ask someone else.
You raised your fist.
My face is turned to you.
The board is squared to your strike.
I brace against the stakes.
I am braced for this blow.
Your fist is not square.
This shield is free.
The middle takes the most effort.
I stand right here.
Go ahead and strike.
I will not flinch at all.
My stakes have bitten into the ground.
I keep blocking the front.
Your fist landed off-centre.
A nail sounded again.
The face took it.
You did not break through.

lines.zh: 钉子扎进土里，我挪不动。
lines.en: The stakes are in the dirt; I don't shift.
Your force is scattering.
One more blow.
The stakes hold the ground.
Your strike went low.
I am fine here.
I have taken every blow.
The fist lands on the board with a dull knock.
I gave less than an inch.
Splinters burst from the nail hole.
A small dip forms in the face.
My face still turns to him.
The two stakes held.
Your knuckles must be red.
That one was solid.
I have taken the force again.
Keep striking.
The board has not split.
Put more into it.
A shield stands behind the line.
Two stakes hold it up.
The base is set in packed earth.
The face looks onto the training ground.
The fresh-cut wood still smells.
All four corners sit true.
It blocks half the path.
The nail heads show.
The wind skims the board.
This is for digimon to train on.
It begins waiting for the first strike.
It waits to be struck.
Fire scorched a black line across my face.
I toppled off the stakes.
Waterlogged wood is too heavy to lift.
The blast knocked my face askew.
Something is nailed into the board.
This light heats the board's face.
Wood does not need feeding.
Lightning ran along the grain.
There is no soil to stand in.
